name: Homogeneous Medium Sampling
definition: A method to determine if a ray interacts with a homogeneous participating medium by sampling the medium with respect to transmittance, computing the interaction distance based on absorption and scattering coefficients.
summary: Homogeneous Medium Sampling determines the distance to the next interaction in a participating medium with uniform optical properties by using the exact inverse CDF of the exponential distribution, which is more efficient than rejection sampling.
